$comment: Where scripts/fetch-art.mjs gets the mascot artwork.
The artwork is NOT in this repository on purpose: it is official game art owned
by Hypergryph and Bushiroad. Shipping it in a public repo would redistribute
someone else's copyrighted asset, so the repo carries only this manifest and the
fetch script. Run `npm run fetch-art` to place the files in art/ locally (art/
Both images are Q-version (chibi) art, which is what the mascot seats want: a
full-body portrait shrinks to an unreadable sliver at 104x172.
urls are tried in order; the first one that yields a non-empty body wins.
`sha256` pins the bytes of a file taken straight from the source. A `cutout`
entry is post-processed by scripts/cutout.mjs (its source sheet carries two
poses on a decorated background), so its pinned hash is the SOURCE's and the
derived file is reported through `derivedSha256` for reference only -- browser
PNG encoding is allowed to differ between Chromium builds.
